commit.message:
switch runtime from wazero to wasm2go via the googlesqlwasm2go module (#7)

The wasm-side execution path moves off the wazero interpreter and
onto a wasm2go-transpiled native-Go implementation. The transpiled
bundle is consumed as a regular Go dependency
(github.com/goccy/googlesqlwasm2go v0.1.0), and the bridge file is
pinned to an upstream artifact-attested release.

Bridge
- googlesql.go is the upstream wasm2go-runtime bridge, downloaded
  from goccy/googlesql-wasm v0.3.1 as `googlesql_wasm2go.go`. The
  download step renames it to googlesql.go in place; `gh
  attestation verify` matches by content digest so the rename does
  not invalidate the signature.

Dependency
- go.mod requires `github.com/goccy/googlesqlwasm2go v0.1.0` (the
  separately-released wasm2go bundle module). The wazero dependency
  is dropped because the wasm body now runs as ordinary Go code.
- The vendored `internal/wasm2go/` tree (~120 chunked .go / .s /
  data files, ~30 MB) is deleted. The same content lives upstream
  in the googlesqlwasm2go module, fetched and integrity-checked by
  the Go module proxy + go.sum.

Build / verify
- The Makefile pulls the wasm2go-runtime bridge from the upstream
  release and verifies its GitHub artifact attestation against the
  signing workflow (goccy/googlesql-wasm/.github/workflows/build.yml).
  The attestation bundle is fetched anonymously from the public
  attestation API and verified offline via
  `gh attestation verify --bundle`; no GH access token is required.
- The previous wasm2go bundle sha256 manifest is gone: bundle
  integrity now flows through go.sum on the googlesqlwasm2go
  dependency, so the only file this repo verifies directly is
  googlesql.go.
- The CI workflow runs `make verify` (job 1) followed by
  `go test ./...` (job 2, gated on verify) on every push / PR.
- TestMain's comment describes the new dual-arch module shape
  (per-chunk amd64.s / arm64.s + pure-Go fallback selected by
  build constraint) instead of the old "pure Go via
  internal/wasm2go" wording.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
deps: bump googlesqlwasm2go to v0.2.0 and regenerate the bridge (#8)

googlesqlwasm2go v0.2.0 vendors googlesql-wasm v0.3.4 (wasmify v0.4.8 /
wasm2go v0.4.4), moving the bundle to the gcasm bare-name layout. Pin it
in go.mod and regenerate googlesql.go from v0.3.4's googlesql_wasm2go.go
so the bridge matches the bundle it drives (env-import set 26 -> 25,
plus the generated marshalling updates). Generated file — DO NOT EDIT.

go build ./... — exit 0
go test ./...  — exit 0

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
